name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2022-02-09.178.1) introduced by NSW Senator [Deborah O'Neill](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/nsw/deborah_o'neill) (Labor), which means it failed. This amendment would have changed the definition of "gene technology." Speaking in opposition to the amendment, Queensland Senator [Murray Watt](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/murray_watt) (Labor) [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2022-02-09.179.1): > *This amendment would change the definition of 'gene technology' to include mitochondrial donation.
